title: Yani abbas
body:
darbar e hussaini ali ke laal ka dar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yahan jo maango wo mil jaata hai
ek naam hai jo kaam aata hai
zehra ki dua kehlaata hai
chauda sadiyon se dunya pe
jis ka parcham lehrata hai
ay matam daaro mere saath pukaro
tu hi raasta hai ya hussain
baab e karam saqqa e haram
har taote dil ki aas ka yani abbas ka
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ye juloos e ashoora ye majlis aur ye matam
ye ishq dilon se na ho kam sar un ka rahe ooncha har dam
jo log uthaate hai parcham
jab aaya moharam har ankh rahe nam hota rahe matam
tu hi raasta hai ya hussain
mashk alam taboot sabeel aur pani darya pyaas ka
yani abbas ka yani abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
har aat moharam jo shehzaade karte hai saqqai
tere ghazi ke hai shedayi ay saani e zahra ke bhai
aabad rahe wo maulai
jo mashk utha kar kehte hai ye ro kar haazir hai ye naukar
tu hi raasta hai ya hussain
karbobla mein pyase bachon ke jeene ki aas ka
yani abbas ka yani abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya ki buri nazron se bachaye rakhna ibne hyder
hum farshe aza ke hai naukar wo nauhakhwan ho ya shayar
tera khaas karam hai un sab par
ye girya o zaari rahe jaari o saari naslon mein hamari
tu hi raasta hai ya hussain
apne har zaakir pe rakhna tum saaya wan'naas ka
yani abbas ka yani abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ho salam un behno par jo khaali jholiyan le kar
aati hai tumhari chaukat par faryad wo karti hai ro kar
maula ho ata ek aisa pisar
roz e ashoora kare khoon ka pursa armaan hai mera
tu hi raasta hai ya hussain
mohsin ban ke zehra ke ghar jo aaya us khaas ka
yani abbas ka yani abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi ye dua karta hoo behno ke sar par rahe chadar
yaad aata hai zainab ka sar bazaar mein jab wo bechadar
kehti thi dekh ke aap ka sar
quran sunao zara dhyaan batao mera saath nibhao
tu hi raasta hai ya hussain
naize se jo khaak pe girta rehta hai us raas ka
yani abbas ka yani abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti ko mila ek din zindan e shaam mein baba ka sar
kaisa tha qayamat ka manzar sar saamne baba ka rakh kar
boli ye sakina ro ro kar
meri jaanib dekho zara aankhein kholo baba kuch bolo
tu hi raasta hai ya hussain
neele rukhsaaron ka gohar chinne ke ehsaas ka
yani abbas ka yani abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne zawwaron ki fehrist mein likhdo naam hamara
ay bali sakina ke baba zeeshan ho ya irfan e aza
karte hai yehi ro ro ke dua
zawwar bana do ab jald sada do darbar dikha do
tu hi raasta hai ya hussain
karbobla tehreer hai jis pe maula us kirtaas ka
yani abbas ka yani abbas ka...
author: Mazhar Abidi
